crossRefs.note: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.
His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.
You will eat bread by the sweat of your face until you return to the ground, for you were taken out of it. For you are…
Yahweh was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.
Yahweh said, “I will destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground—man, along with animals, creeping…
I, Yahweh, have spoken. I will surely do this to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against me. In…
in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?
If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,
all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.
and the dust returns to the earth as it was, and the spirit returns to God who gave it.

translations.web: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”
translations.bsb: You return man to dust, saying, “Return, O sons of mortals.”
translations.kjv: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.
translations.asv: Thou turnest man to destruction, And sayest, Return, ye children of men.
